# Similarweb

> Similarweb is a digital intelligence platform providing competitive data and AI search optimization tools for marketers, SEOs, researchers, and business strategists. Similarweb's AI Search Intelligence suite helps brands track, measure, and improve their visibility and traffic across generative AI platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and Deepseek. Similarweb also provides free web analytics tools, keyword research, and comprehensive competitive intelligence for websites, apps, and ecommerce.

Similarweb's AI search offering spans two core capabilities: AI Brand Visibility (tracking where and how brands are mentioned, cited, and positioned in Gen AI answers) and AI Traffic Analysis (measuring real traffic driven from Gen AI platforms to any website). Together, these form the AI Search Intelligence suite, the only solution combining brand visibility and traffic measurement for generative AI search.

The blog's GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) category is Similarweb's primary thought leadership hub for AI search strategy, covering measurement frameworks, implementation tactics, competitive analysis, and ROI methodology. Similarweb coined and actively develops the GEO discipline, distinguishing it from AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and traditional SEO.

- [AI Citation Analysis](https://www.similarweb.com/md/citation-analysis.md): Identify which URLs are cited in AI-generated answers for your tracked topics, measure citation influence scores, and find content gaps

- [AI Chatbot Traffic Analysis](https://www.similarweb.com/md/ai-chatbot-traffic.md): Measure real traffic driven from Gen AI platforms to any website, including landing page analysis and the user prompts behind each click
